scenario: [LNLS.3.8] names `String`-typed slots: an Int ordering across two patterns, on top of a full key anchor, compiles under `+nolinscan` -- [LNLS.3.3] allows "range comparisons ... on top of this anchor". PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate.string_slot`'s `lk_string` test inside `lnls_compare`.
rules_ds:
use default:
    linear_scan: false

schema Left scope logical:
    k: Int key
    n: Int mutable

schema Right scope logical:
    k: Int key
    n: Int mutable

rule r:
    Left a
    Right b where b.k == a.k and b.n > a.n
->
    log info "x"
